title: JFK killed for UFO cooperation breaking the power structure's deal
summary: Matthew Pines tells of JFK killed for UFO cooperation breaking the power structure's deal, about 1963 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Rogan's view that UFOs were the main reason JFK was killed

plain: This is the idea that President John F. Kennedy was killed in 1963 partly because of UFOs. A researcher, Matthew Pines, frames it as a hidden deal among the powerful: if a president went too far toward easing tensions with the Soviet Union, getting rid of nuclear weapons, or sharing space work and possible UFO technology, that would cut to the core of the deal. If true, the UFO secret was worth killing a president over. Steven Greer, a man who says UFO secrets are held by a global secret group, says he knows people with solid intelligence on it, calls it a fact, and says Kennedy's brother Robert knew. Harold Malmgren, described as a former presidential adviser, says he thinks UFOs were probably the number one issue behind the killing. The podcast host Jesse Michels repeats this as something like a deathbed confession from an 89-year-old Kennedy adviser, and the podcast host Joe Rogan restates Malmgren's words. The tellers mostly differ on why: Pines points to the deal, while the others give no reason.
